why_ai: Regulated money rails and supervisory accountability keep the platform needed, though engineering is automatable.
why_clarity: Accounts, cards and ledgers are defined API primitives with testable behaviour.
why_digital: Developer APIs, transaction data and online delivery to remote fintech programmes.

why_ai: Sponsor bank relationships are negotiated by people and are the category's existential dependency.
why_clarity: Each bank relationship is negotiated once, differently, with outcomes known only when a bank exits.
why_digital: Relationships run through meetings and email with a small set of banks.

why_ai: Assembling and reformatting oversight records per bank is generation and mapping work AI handles.
why_clarity: The same oversight record is reproduced in each bank's format on a cadence.
why_digital: Documents, spreadsheets and records in, evidence packages out, all digital.

why_ai: Inferring customer treatment from API call patterns is a modelling problem, with accountable sign-off.
why_clarity: Fair treatment has no fixed definition and examiners confirm problems much later.
why_digital: Transaction and API event streams in, alerts and findings out.

why_ai: Pure modelling over data already collected; only the unique cross-programme vantage protects it.
why_clarity: Predictions over programme data are testable as outcomes accrue over months.
why_digital: Transaction records in, predictive models out, all on screens.

why_ai: Regulation-defined protections become enforceable platform defaults rather than human work.
why_clarity: Fund access, dispute and error-resolution rules are written in regulation with checkable timelines.
why_digital: Account events in, enforced protections and disclosures out, online.

why_ai: Continuous reconciliation is matching software; liability for customer funds keeps it core infrastructure.
why_clarity: The sub-ledger either matches money held at the bank or it does not.
why_digital: Ledger and bank balance data in, reconciliation results out.

why_ai: Twenty recurring archetypes rebuilt by hand are a pattern library waiting for automation.
why_clarity: The same programme archetypes recur, each with defined bank constraints.
why_digital: Configuration of accounts, cards and rules done entirely in software.

why_ai: Supervisory accountability sits here, but both detection and evidence are automatable.
why_clarity: Oversight duties are new and loosely defined across dozens of differing programmes.
why_digital: API activity in, oversight records and alerts out, all digital.

why_ai: Alert triage needs product context, which automated context assembly supplies.
why_clarity: High-volume alert queues, though judging suspicion depends on each programme's norms.
why_digital: Alert queues and transaction data reviewed on screens.

why_ai: Scarce engineers carry unwritten bank requirements in their heads and guide each novel build.
why_clarity: Knowledge lives in calls and Slack threads, and each programme design differs.
why_digital: Calls, docs and code with remote developer teams.
